title: Set up a workflow
blurb: Automate follow-ups, reminders and lead nurturing, or let AI build it.

steps.title: Open Automation
steps.body: Workflows do your follow-up for you. Click **Automation** in the left menu.

steps.title: Just describe it
steps.body:
The fastest way: type what you want in **What do you want to automate?** and press the arrow. For example:
**When someone fills in my contact form, email them a welcome message and text me their details.**
AI builds the workflow for you to check.
steps.lookFor: What do you want to automate?

steps.title: Or start from a template
steps.body: Scroll down to **Start with a Template**. Good first picks: **Appointment Confirmation**, **Email Drip Sequence** and **FAQ Auto Reply**.

steps.title: Or build from scratch
steps.body: Click **Create workflow**, then **Start from scratch**. Add a **Trigger** (what starts it, like a form submitted), then press **+** to add actions like Send Email, Send SMS or Wait.

steps.title: Test, then publish
steps.body: Inside your workflow, use **Test Workflow** with your own contact first. When it looks right, switch **Draft** to **Publish** at the top right and click **Save**.
steps.tip: Nothing runs until it's published. That makes it safe to experiment.
